about: A reading full of code names comes back as what it amounts to, in ordinary words.

messages.content: What has the auth refactor been up to?

{"happened": [{"record": "9a1f3c2e-0b7d-4e55-8c1a-2f6d9e0b3a71", "what": "The user asked:
The refresh token is expiring early in prod, can you find out why and fix it"}, {"record": "1c4e8b2a-7d3f-4a91-b0e6-5f2c8d7a9e13", "what": "Claude ran rg -n "refresh_token" src/auth (Find where refresh tokens are handled)
Output: src/auth/refresh.py:12:def refresh_token(session):
src/auth/refresh.py:40:    expires_at = issued_at + timedelta(seconds=REFRESH_TTL)"}, {"record": "e7b2d4a1-3c9f-4b8e-a6d0-8f1e2c5b7a94", "what": "Claude said:
Found it: `REFRESH_TTL` is read in seconds but configured in minutes, so tokens expire sixty times too soon."}, {"record": "4d8a1e6c-2b7f-4c93-9e0a-7b5d3f1c8e26", "what": "Claude edited src/auth/refresh.py
Changed: expires_at = issued_at + timedelta(minutes=REFRESH_TTL)"}, {"record": "b3f7c1d9-6e2a-4d84-8b1f-0c9e5a7d2f68", "what": "Claude ran uv run pytest tests/test_refresh.py -q (Run the refresh tests)
Output: 14 passed in 0.82s"}, {"record": "7e2c9a4b-1d6f-4e30-a8b5-3c7f9d1e6a52", "what": "Claude said:
Fixed: `refresh_token` now reads `REFRESH_TTL` as minutes. `test_refresh.py` passes, 14 of 14."}], "more": false, "working": false, "more_since": "7e2c9a4b-1d6f-4e30-a8b5-3c7f9d1e6a52"}
